scope: Pure CPU actual installed official Planner.TOPP only; no scene, IK/RRT, physics, GPU or physical IO

retiming.method: Actual official MPlib TOPP, separately on each two-endpoint native RRT segment; no minimum duration or global speed override
retiming.native_vs_dense_timing_note: Installed TOPP uses linspace(T,int(T/step)); returned native times are preserved. Official take_dense_action executes one physical dt per row. Wrench must use physical dt, not native time.
retiming.curve: Each actual native two-point spline is certified affine. Returned samples are collinear, monotonic and match endpoints. Fresh continuous mesh audit covers precisely these actual native curves; no old certificate reused.
